description: An open-plan luxury interior spanning foyer, hallway, kitchen, and stair hall photographed at standing eye-level with a wide lens in a one-point perspective composition looking down the main circulation axis. The camera is positioned in the combined living-kitchen zone, revealing a deep receding corridor leading to a dark walnut entry door in the far background. The ceiling is warm cream with a recessed stepped tray detail. A continuous warm amber accent glow runs along hidden coves at the ceiling perimeter and at stair-riser level, casting a band of indirect golden warmth throughout. The left wall is fully clad in wide-plank natural light oak with fine linear texture, meeting a floating staircase with white Calacatta marble treads and matte black slim steel railings rising from the left foreground. The kitchen zone occupies the right side: a large island clad in full-slab Calacatta marble with a dramatic book-matched veining pattern serves three white leather-upholstered bar stools with matte black legs. Dark charcoal flat-panel kitchen cabinetry lines the right wall above white marble-slab backsplash, with an integrated oven and brushed nickel sink fittings. A console table in white marble with a black metal base holds a tall textured ceramic vase with dried terracotta branches. The floor throughout is large-format cream travertine tile. The palette is a richly layered combination of warm oak, cream, Calacatta white-and-grey, dark charcoal, and matte black. The atmosphere is architecturally precise, sophisticated, and quietly dramatic.
